title: fix(rest): the one-request record page refuses a related list keyed by a user field — 'owner' is not a lookup or master-detail field that references 'sys_user'
body:
## Regression in 18.3.0, from objectstack-ai/duly#185

**Repro:** a record page on `sys_user` (duly's `duly_member`) declares a related list of `duly_task` keyed by `owner`, which is a `Field.user`. Open it full page at `/sys_user/record/<id>/page/duly_member`.

**18.2.0:** the page renders.

**18.3.0:** the console shows "could not load this record / VALIDATION_FAILED". The request `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user/<id>/page` answers:

```
400 VALIDATION_FAILED: 'owner' on 'duly_task' is not a lookup or master-detail field that references 'sys_user'.
```

**Cause:** in `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts` (the one-request record page, #27713 / #28682), the related-list check accepts only `RELATIONSHIP_TYPES` (lookup, master_detail) whose reference is the page's object. A `user` field references `sys_user` by definition, but it is refused.

**Expected:** a `user` field (and an `owner` field, if that is a separate type) counts as a relationship to `sys_user` in this check, as it does in the related list's own row query.

**Impact:** any app record page on `sys_user` with a related list by an owner or assignee user field fails to open full page.

Separately, in the same pass: a `url` action at `record_header` on `sys_user` (served in the metadata) no longer renders in the 18.3 console's header menu, in the drawer or on the full page. 18.2 rendered it. Evidence is in the duly project's `duly-18.3-browser-check/REPORT.md` (R1).
